question_en: Low resistance can be measured by:
question_gu: Low resistance માપવા માટે કયું instrument/bridge વપરાય છે?
explanation_en: Kelvin's double bridge is designed for accurate measurement of very low resistances while minimizing lead and contact resistance effects.
explanation_gu: Kelvin double bridge very low resistance માટે ઉપયોગી છે અને lead/contact resistanceની અસર ઘટાડે છે.
tip_en: Low resistance → Kelvin double bridge.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following pressure gauges is used for measuring pressure in the range of 10^−10 Torr?
question_gu: 10^−10 Torr rangeનું pressure માપવા કયું pressure gauge વપરાય છે?
explanation_en: Hot-cathode ionization gauges can measure ultra-high vacuum pressures down to around 10^−10 Torr, within suitable operating conditions.
explanation_gu: Hot-cathode ionization gauge ultra-high vacuum, આશરે 10^−10 Torr range, માટે વપરાય છે.
tip_en: Ultra-high vacuum → ionization/hot-cathode gauge.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: At low value of magnetic field the transverse magnetoresistance is:
question_gu: Low magnetic field પર transverse magnetoresistance કેવી રીતે vary થાય છે?

options.C: Proportional to the square of the field
options.D: Inversely proportional to the square of the field

explanation_en: In the low-field regime, ordinary transverse magnetoresistance is commonly quadratic in magnetic field: Δρ/ρ ∝ B².
explanation_gu: Low-field regimeમાં transverse magnetoresistance સામાન્ય રીતે B² સાથે proportional હોય છે: Δρ/ρ∝B².
tip_en: Low-field magnetoresistance → B² dependence.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A workshop superintendent measures temperature of a boiler. He will use:
question_gu: Workshop superintendent boilerનું temperature માપવા માટે શું વાપરશે?
explanation_en: A boiler can be measured remotely at high temperature using a radiation pyrometer, which determines temperature from thermal radiation.
explanation_gu: Boilerનું high temperature remote measurement radiation pyrometerથી કરી શકાય છે.
tip_en: High-temperature non-contact measurement → radiation pyrometer.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: For two resistances R1=100±0.1 Ω and R2=50±0.03 Ω find the value of equivalent resistance when they are connected in parallel:
question_gu: R1=100±0.1 Ω અને R2=50±0.03 Ω parallelમાં જોડાય ત્યારે equivalent resistance શોધો.
explanation_en: The nominal parallel resistance is R=R1R2/(R1+R2)=33.33 Ω. Propagating independent absolute uncertainties by first-order differentials gives an uncertainty of about 0.068 Ω for the stated values, matching D.
explanation_gu: Nominal R=R1R2/(R1+R2)=33.33 Ω. First-order error propagationથી uncertainty આશરે 0.068 Ω મળે છે, એટલે D.
tip_en: For parallel resistance, propagate uncertainty through partial derivatives.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Laser light is not:

explanation_en: Laser light is coherent, highly directional and can be very intense. Therefore it is not non-coherent.

question_en: Pauli's exclusion principle states that:
question_gu: Pauli exclusion principle શું કહે છે?

options.A: Two electrons cannot have all the quantum numbers same
options.B: Two electrons can have all the quantum numbers same

question_en: The Bohr model gives the value for ionization potential of Li2+ ion as:
question_gu: Bohr model મુજબ Li²⁺ ionનું ionization potential કેટલું છે?

question_en: The normal Zeeman effect is:
question_gu: Normal Zeeman effect શું છે?

options.A: Not a confirmation of space quantization

question_en: Arrange energy differences involved in electronic transitions, vibrational transitions and rotational transitions in ascending order:
question_gu: Electronic, vibrational અને rotational transitionsમાં energy differencesને ascending orderમાં ગોઠવો.

question_en: The number of nearest neighbours for mon-atomic F.C.C. structure is:
question_gu: Mon-atomic F.C.C. structureમાં nearest neighbours કેટલા હોય છે?
explanation_en: An FCC lattice has coordination number 12.

question_en: Bragg's law in terms of reciprocal lattice vector G is:
question_gu: Reciprocal lattice vector Gના termsમાં Bragg's law કયું છે?
explanation_en: For elastic diffraction, |k+G|²=|k|², giving 2k·G+G²=0.

question_en: Binding energy per nucleon for the nuclei ⁴He, ⁵⁶Fe, ¹⁹⁷Au and ²³⁵U are given as BE1, BE2, BE3 and BE4 respectively. Which order is correct?
question_gu: ⁴He, ⁵⁶Fe, ¹⁹⁷Au અને ²³⁵U માટે binding energy per nucleon BE1, BE2, BE3, BE4 હોય તો સાચો order કયો?
explanation_en: Typical binding energies per nucleon are approximately He-4 7.1 MeV, Fe-56 8.8 MeV, Au-197 7.9 MeV and U-235 7.6 MeV. Thus BE2>BE3>BE4>BE1.
explanation_gu: Approximate B.E./nucleon: He-4 7.1, Fe-56 8.8, Au-197 7.9, U-235 7.6 MeV. તેથી BE2>BE3>BE4>BE1.
tip_en: Maximum binding energy per nucleon is near Fe/Ni.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The quark structure of Δ++ is:

question_en: A thermal neutron having speed v collides with ²³⁵U nucleus. The absorption cross-section is proportional to:

question_en: The decay chain of the nucleus ²³⁸U involves eight α-decays and six β-decays. The final nucleus at the end of the process will have:
question_gu: ²³⁸U decay chainમાં 8 α-decays અને 6 β-decays થાય તો final nucleus શું હશે?
explanation_en: Eight alpha decays reduce A by 32 and Z by 16: A=206, Z=76. Six beta-minus decays increase Z by 6 to 82, leaving A unchanged. Thus Z=82, A=206.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key
